📘 Rule violations (1) ---
🟠 **Medium**
1. Byte-list decoding still accepts mismatched element lengths 📘 Rule violation
>
>Description >
> >
>The PR changes only the declared CQL type of ByteListToArrayCodec, which inherits
>AbstractPrimitiveListToArrayCodec.decode, and that shared decode path is left untouched. The PR
>description states that element length-prefix validation is deliberately out of scope, so a list
>whose element lengths do not match sizeOfComponentType() is still decoded without a check and can
>be silently misread. This gap is the one the ticket-derived rule asks to close, and it remains open
>after merge for every primitive list-to-array codec, including the byte codec this PR fixes.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[core/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/driver/internal/core/type/codec/extras/array/ByteListToArrayCodec.java[R43-45]](https://github.com/scylladb/java-driver/pull/1468/files#diff-0cf850765a07d8ec2884b20ad4003c69b660b0494f6c12a2ec49a18c3ecc7ea4R43-R45) > >```diff > public ByteListToArrayCodec() { >- super(DataTypes.listOf(DataTypes.SMALLINT), GenericType.of(byte[].class)); >+ super(DataTypes.listOf(DataTypes.TINYINT), GenericType.of(byte[].class)); > } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The primitive list-to-array codecs, including `ByteListToArrayCodec`, inherit `AbstractPrimitiveListToArrayCodec.decode`. That method does not check each element's length prefix against `sizeOfComponentType()`, so a malformed or mismatched list can be silently misread or fail with a `BufferUnderflowException` instead of a descriptive error. The ticket-derived requirement (rule 6648) asks for a descriptive `IllegalArgumentException` on mismatch. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- core/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/driver/internal/core/type/codec/extras/array/AbstractPrimitiveListToArrayCodec.java[decode method] >- core/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/driver/internal/core/type/codec/extras/array/ByteListToArrayCodec.java[44-45] > >## Recommended Fix >In `AbstractPrimitiveListToArrayCodec.decode`, for each element read the 4-byte length prefix, compare it with `sizeOfComponentType()`, and throw `IllegalArgumentException` with the index, expected size and actual size on mismatch. Add unit tests in the codec test package that feed an element with a wrong length and assert the exception. Keep the change in the shared base class so all primitive list codecs are covered. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
